private theorem radix_120199 : (radix : ZMod 120199) = 4237 := by
  change ((2 : ℕ)^47 : ZMod 120199) = 4237
  simp only [Nat.cast_ofNat]
  reduce_mod_char

private theorem start_weight : selectorWeight start = 34876427265 := by decide +kernel

/-- These are residues of the original literal kernel, not a replacement. -/
theorem K_cast_47 : (K : ZMod 47) = 26 := by
  rw [K, rawWord_cast, radix_47, rows_47, controls_47, start_weight]
  reduce_mod_char

theorem K_cast_2011 : (K : ZMod 2011) = 1995 := by
  rw [K, rawWord_cast, radix_2011, rows_2011, controls_2011, start_weight]
  reduce_mod_char

theorem K_cast_auxiliary : (K : ZMod 120199) = 114787 := by
  rw [K, rawWord_cast, radix_120199, rows_120199, controls_120199, start_weight]
  reduce_mod_char

private theorem mod_of_cast {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (a b : ℕ)
    (h : (a : ZMod m) = (b : ZMod m)) (hb : b < m) : a % m = b := by
  have hv := congrArg ZMod.val h
  simpa only [ZMod.val_natCast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hb] using hv

private theorem transport_modulus (a m n r : ℕ) (hm : m = n)
    (h : a % m = r) : a % n = r := hm ▸ h

attribute [local irreducible] CurrentKernel2011.K CurrentControllerData2011.B

theorem K_mod_47 : K % 47 = 26 := mod_of_cast K 26 K_cast_47 (by decide)
theorem K_mod_2011 : K % 2011 = 1995 := mod_of_cast K 1995 K_cast_2011 (by decide)
theorem K_mod_auxiliary : K % 120199 = 114787 :=
  mod_of_cast K 114787 K_cast_auxiliary (by decide)

/-- The formerly conditional controller H residues are now unconditional. -/
theorem Hs_mod_47 :
    (1+CurrentControllerData2011.B*K+CurrentControllerData2011.B^2) % 47 = 29 :=
  CurrentControllerData2011.Hs_mod_47 K_mod_47

theorem Hs_mod_2011 :
    (1+CurrentControllerData2011.B*K+CurrentControllerData2011.B^2) % 2011 = 674 :=
  CurrentControllerData2011.Hs_mod_2011 K_mod_2011

theorem Hs_mod_auxiliary :
    (1+CurrentControllerData2011.B*K+CurrentControllerData2011.B^2) % 120199 = 36379 :=
  transport_modulus _ CurrentControllerData2011.auxiliary 120199 36379 rfl
    (CurrentControllerData2011.Hs_mod_auxiliary
      (transport_modulus K 120199 CurrentControllerData2011.auxiliary 114787 rfl
        K_mod_auxiliary))

theorem one_lt_of_not_square {p g : ℕ} (h : ¬ p^2 ∣ g-1) : 1 < g := by
  by_contra hn
  have hz : g-1 = 0 := by omega
  exact h (hz ▸ dvd_zero _)

theorem not_dvd_of_dvd_sub_one {p g : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p)
    (hg : 1 ≤ g) (hd : p ∣ g-1) : ¬ p ∣ g := by
  intro h
  have hh := Nat.dvd_sub h hd
  have he : g-(g-1) = 1 := by omega
  exact hp.not_dvd_one (he ▸ hh)

/-- Natural subtraction is used only after proving the needed lower bound. -/
theorem pow_cast_eq_one_iff {g m : ℕ} (hg : 1 ≤ g) (k : ℕ) :
    (g : ZMod m)^k = 1 ↔ m ∣ g^k-1 := by
  have hk : 1 ≤ g^k := one_le_pow₀ hg
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply (CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff (ZMod m) m (g^k-1)).mp
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hk, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_one, h, sub_self]
  · intro h
    have hz := (CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff (ZMod m) m (g^k-1)).mpr h
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hk, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_one] at hz
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz

/-- LTE gives exact valuation k+1, not merely a divisibility lower bound. -/
theorem exact_lift {p g : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (ho : Odd p)
    (hd : p ∣ g-1) (hs : ¬ p^2 ∣ g-1) (k : ℕ) :
    p^(k+1) ∣ g^(p^k)-1 ∧ ¬ p^(k+2) ∣ g^(p^k)-1 := by
  have hg := one_lt_of_not_square hs
  have hnd := not_dvd_of_dvd_sub_one hp hg.le hd
  have hbase : emultiplicity p (g-1) = (1 : ℕ) :=
    emultiplicity_eq_coe.mpr (by simpa only [pow_one] using And.intro hd hs)
  have hval := Nat.emultiplicity_pow_sub_pow hp ho hd hnd (p^k)
  have hv : emultiplicity p (g^(p^k)-1) = ((k+1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
    simpa only [one_pow, hbase, emultiplicity_pow_self_of_prime hp.prime,
      Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_comm] using hval
  simpa only [Nat.add_assoc] using (emultiplicity_eq_coe.mp hv)

/-- The modulus p is included: the order is p^0=1. -/
theorem order_succ {p g : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (ho : Odd p)
    (hd : p ∣ g-1) (hs : ¬ p^2 ∣ g-1) (k : ℕ) :
    orderOf (g : ZMod (p^(k+1))) = p^k := by
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  have hg := (one_lt_of_not_square hs).le
  cases k with
  | zero =>
      rw [pow_zero]
      apply orderOf_eq_one_iff.mpr
      have h := (pow_cast_eq_one_iff (m:=p^(0+1)) hg 1).mpr (by simpa using hd)
      simpa only [pow_one] using h
  | succ k =>
      apply orderOf_eq_prime_pow (p:=p) (n:=k)
      · rw [pow_cast_eq_one_iff hg]
        simpa only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_assoc] using
          (exact_lift hp ho hd hs k).2
      · rw [pow_cast_eq_one_iff hg]
        simpa only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_assoc] using
          (exact_lift hp ho hd hs (k+1)).1

theorem order_prime_power {p g n : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (ho : Odd p)
    (hd : p ∣ g-1) (hs : ¬ p^2 ∣ g-1) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    orderOf (g : ZMod (p^n)) = p^(n-1) := by
  obtain ⟨k,rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : n ≠ 0)
  simpa only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_sub_cancel] using order_succ hp ho hd hs k

theorem generator_gt_one : 1 < B^(auxiliary-1) := by
  have hm := Nat.mod_le (B^(auxiliary-1)) (auxiliary^2)
  rw [auxiliary_lift] at hm
  omega

theorem generator_mod_prime : B^(auxiliary-1) % auxiliary = 1 := by
  calc
    B^(auxiliary-1) % auxiliary =
        (B^(auxiliary-1) % auxiliary^2) % auxiliary :=
      (Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ (dvd_pow_self auxiliary (by decide : 2 ≠ 0))).symm
    _ = 1 := by rw [auxiliary_lift]; decide

/-- Actual p-divisibility, with no supplied principal-unit premise. -/
theorem generator_dvd : auxiliary ∣ B^(auxiliary-1)-1 := by
  apply (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' generator_gt_one.le).mp
  change 1 % auxiliary = B^(auxiliary-1) % auxiliary
  rw [generator_mod_prime]
  decide

/-- The checked nonzero first lift excludes divisibility by p². -/
theorem generator_not_square : ¬ auxiliary^2 ∣ B^(auxiliary-1)-1 := by
  intro hd
  have he := (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' generator_gt_one.le).mpr hd
  change 1 % auxiliary^2 = B^(auxiliary-1) % auxiliary^2 at he
  have h1 : 1 % auxiliary^2 = 1 := by decide
  exact lift_ne_one (he.symm.trans h1)

theorem generator_not_dvd : ¬ auxiliary ∣ B^(auxiliary-1) :=
  not_dvd_of_dvd_sub_one prime_auxiliary generator_gt_one.le generator_dvd

theorem generator_exact_lift (k : ℕ) :
    auxiliary^(k+1) ∣ (B^(auxiliary-1))^(auxiliary^k)-1 ∧
      ¬ auxiliary^(k+2) ∣ (B^(auxiliary-1))^(auxiliary^k)-1 :=
  exact_lift prime_auxiliary auxiliary_odd generator_dvd generator_not_square k

theorem generator_order_succ (k : ℕ) :
    orderOf ((B : ZMod (auxiliary^(k+1)))^(auxiliary-1)) = auxiliary^k := by
  simpa only [Nat.cast_pow] using
    order_succ prime_auxiliary auxiliary_odd generator_dvd generator_not_square k

theorem generator_order (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    orderOf ((B : ZMod (auxiliary^n))^(auxiliary-1)) = auxiliary^(n-1) := by
  simpa only [Nat.cast_pow] using
    order_prime_power prime_auxiliary auxiliary_odd generator_dvd generator_not_square hn

theorem order_product {a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (x k : ℕ) :
    orderOf ((x : ZMod (a*b))^k) =
      Nat.lcm (orderOf ((x : ZMod a)^k)) (orderOf ((x : ZMod b)^k)) := by
  let e := ZMod.chineseRemainder hab
  have hm : e ((x : ZMod (a*b))^k) = ((x : ZMod a)^k,(x : ZMod b)^k) := by
    rw [map_pow, map_natCast]
    rfl
  calc
    _ = orderOf (e ((x : ZMod (a*b))^k)) :=
      (e.toMulEquiv.orderOf_eq _).symm
    _ = orderOf (((x : ZMod a)^k,(x : ZMod b)^k)) := congrArg orderOf hm
    _ = _ := Prod.orderOf_mk

theorem generator_cast_47 : (B : ZMod 47)^(auxiliary-1) = 1 := by
  rw [← orderOf_dvd_iff_pow_eq_one, B_order_47]
  have hd : 23 ∣ spacing := by rw [← spacing_lcm]; exact Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _
  exact hd.trans spacing_dvd

theorem generator_cast_2011 : (B : ZMod 2011)^(auxiliary-1) = 1 := by
  rw [← orderOf_dvd_iff_pow_eq_one, B_order_2011]
  have hd : 402 ∣ spacing := by rw [← spacing_lcm]; exact Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _
  exact hd.trans spacing_dvd

theorem generator_cast_fixed : (B : ZMod d)^(auxiliary-1) = 1 := by
  change (B : ZMod (47*2011))^(auxiliary-1) = 1
  apply orderOf_eq_one_iff.mp
  rw [order_product fixed_coprime, generator_cast_47, generator_cast_2011]
  simp

theorem generator_cast_auxiliary : (B : ZMod auxiliary)^(auxiliary-1) = 1 := by
  have hc : ((B^(auxiliary-1) : ℕ) : ZMod auxiliary) = ((1 : ℕ) : ZMod auxiliary) :=
    (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff' _ _ _).mpr (by rw [generator_mod_prime]; decide)
  simpa only [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_one] using hc

theorem fixed_auxiliary_coprime : Nat.Coprime d auxiliary := by decide

/-- The fixed factor contributes order1; the entire order comes from p^n. -/
theorem full_order (k : ℕ) :
    orderOf ((B : ZMod (d*auxiliary^(k+1)))^(auxiliary-1)) = auxiliary^k := by
  rw [order_product (fixed_auxiliary_coprime.pow_right (k+1)),
    generator_cast_fixed, generator_order_succ]
  simp

theorem generator_cast_C0 : (B : ZMod (d*auxiliary))^(auxiliary-1) = 1 := by
  apply orderOf_eq_one_iff.mp
  rw [order_product fixed_auxiliary_coprime, generator_cast_fixed,
    generator_cast_auxiliary]
  simp

/-- Explicit modulus transport avoids any evaluation of the huge base. -/
private theorem order_transport (x k m n : ℕ) (h : m = n) :
    orderOf ((x : ZMod m)^k) = orderOf ((x : ZMod n)^k) := by
  subst n
  rfl

theorem modulus_factorization (k : ℕ) : (d*auxiliary)*auxiliary^k = d*auxiliary^(k+1) := by
  rw [pow_succ]
  ring

theorem block_order (k : ℕ) :
    orderOf ((B : ZMod ((d*auxiliary)*auxiliary^k))^(auxiliary-1)) = auxiliary^k :=
  (order_transport B (auxiliary-1) _ _ (modulus_factorization k)).trans (full_order k)

theorem block_projection (k : ℕ) :
    ZMod.castHom (dvd_mul_right (d*auxiliary) (auxiliary^k)) (ZMod (d*auxiliary))
      ((B : ZMod ((d*auxiliary)*auxiliary^k))^(auxiliary-1)) = 1 := by
  rw [map_pow, map_natCast]
  exact generator_cast_C0

/-- A full coordinate equivalence is constructed for every auxiliary power. -/
theorem exists_coordinates (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ e : ZMod (auxiliary^k) ≃ ZMod (auxiliary^k), ∀ z : ZMod (auxiliary^k),
      ((B : ZMod ((d*auxiliary)*auxiliary^k))^(auxiliary-1))^(e z).val =
        1+((d*auxiliary : ℕ) : ZMod ((d*auxiliary)*auxiliary^k))*
          (z.val : ZMod ((d*auxiliary)*auxiliary^k)) :=
  ControllerPowerCoordinates.exists_power_coordinates (by decide)
    ((B : ZMod ((d*auxiliary)*auxiliary^k))^(auxiliary-1))
    (block_projection k) (block_order k)

/-- The same constructed coordinates, written as powers of the actual B. -/
theorem exists_base_power_coordinates (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ e : ZMod (auxiliary^k) ≃ ZMod (auxiliary^k), ∀ z : ZMod (auxiliary^k),
      (B : ZMod ((d*auxiliary)*auxiliary^k))^((auxiliary-1)*(e z).val) =
        1+((d*auxiliary : ℕ) : ZMod ((d*auxiliary)*auxiliary^k))*
          (z.val : ZMod ((d*auxiliary)*auxiliary^k)) := by
  obtain ⟨e,he⟩ := exists_coordinates k
  exact ⟨e,fun z => by rw [pow_mul]; exact he z⟩

theorem exists_power_coordinates {C0 T : ℕ} [NeZero T] (hC0 : 1 < C0)
    (g : ZMod (C0*T))
    (hproject : ZMod.castHom (dvd_mul_right C0 T) (ZMod C0) g = 1)
    (horder : orderOf g = T) :
    ∃ e : ZMod T ≃ ZMod T, ∀ z : ZMod T,
      g^(e z).val = 1+(C0 : ZMod (C0*T))*(z.val : ZMod (C0*T)) := by
  classical
  letI : NeZero C0 := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hex (j : ZMod T) : ∃ u : ZMod T,
      g^j.val = 1+(C0 : ZMod (C0*T))*(u.val : ZMod (C0*T)) := by
    have hp : ZMod.castHom (dvd_mul_right C0 T) (ZMod C0) (g^j.val) = (1 : ℕ) := by
      rw [map_pow, hproject, one_pow, Nat.cast_one]
    simpa only [Nat.cast_one] using
      ControllerResidueLift.exists_coordinate (g^j.val) 1 hC0 hp
  choose u hu using hex
  have hinj : Function.Injective u := by
    intro i j hij
    have hp : g^i.val = g^j.val := by rw [hu i, hu j, hij]
    have hi : i.val < orderOf g := by rw [horder]; exact ZMod.val_lt i
    have hj : j.val < orderOf g := by rw [horder]; exact ZMod.val_lt j
    apply ZMod.val_injective
    exact pow_injOn_Iio_orderOf hi hj hp
  let f : ZMod T ≃ ZMod T :=
    Equiv.ofBijective u ⟨hinj, Finite.surjective_of_injective hinj⟩
  refine ⟨f.symm,?_⟩
  intro z
  have hz : u (f.symm z) = z := f.apply_symm_apply z
  rw [hu, hz]

def dimension (n : ℕ) : ℕ := auxiliary^n
def q (n : ℕ) : ℕ := B^(dimension n)
def A (rw : ℕ) : ℕ := CurrentKernel2011.K+B^(dimension rw)
def Gamma (rw n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  CurrentMasks2011.radix^977*(q n^2-1)*(1+q n*A rw)

theorem dimension_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < dimension n :=
  pow_pos prime_auxiliary.pos n

theorem B_gt_one : 1 < B := by
  rw [B_eq]
  exact one_lt_pow₀ (by decide) (by decide)

attribute [local irreducible] CurrentKernel2011.K CurrentControllerData2011.B

theorem q_gt_one (n : ℕ) : 1 < q n :=
  one_lt_pow₀ B_gt_one (Nat.ne_of_gt (dimension_pos n))

theorem quadratic_ge_one (n : ℕ) : 1 ≤ q n^2 := by
  have := q_gt_one n
  nlinarith

theorem auxiliary_modEq_23 : auxiliary ≡ 1 [MOD 23] := by decide
theorem auxiliary_modEq_402 : auxiliary ≡ 1 [MOD 402] := by decide

/-- Exact power reduction at the first fixed prime, for every exponent. -/
theorem power_dimension_47 (n : ℕ) :
    ((B^(dimension n) : ℕ) : ZMod 47) = (B : ZMod 47) := by
  have he : dimension n ≡ 1 [MOD 23] := by
    simpa only [dimension, one_pow] using auxiliary_modEq_23.pow n
  have hp : (B : ZMod 47)^23 = 1 := by
    rw [← B_order_47]
    exact pow_orderOf_eq_one _
  simpa only [Nat.cast_pow, pow_one] using pow_eq_pow_of_modEq he hp

/-- The second fixed-prime order is 402, not 2010. -/
theorem power_dimension_2011 (n : ℕ) :
    ((B^(dimension n) : ℕ) : ZMod 2011) = (B : ZMod 2011) := by
  have he : dimension n ≡ 1 [MOD 402] := by
    simpa only [dimension, one_pow] using auxiliary_modEq_402.pow n
  have hp : (B : ZMod 2011)^402 = 1 := by
    rw [← B_order_2011]
    exact pow_orderOf_eq_one _
  simpa only [Nat.cast_pow, pow_one] using pow_eq_pow_of_modEq he hp

/-- Frobenius handles all auxiliary powers, including auxiliary^0 = 1. -/
theorem power_dimension_auxiliary (n : ℕ) :
    ((B^(dimension n) : ℕ) : ZMod auxiliary) = (B : ZMod auxiliary) := by
  letI : Fact auxiliary.Prime := ⟨prime_auxiliary⟩
  simpa only [dimension, Nat.cast_pow] using
    (ZMod.pow_card_pow (n := n) (B : ZMod auxiliary))

theorem q_cast_47 (n : ℕ) : (q n : ZMod 47) = 37 :=
  (power_dimension_47 n).trans B_cast_47
theorem q_cast_2011 (n : ℕ) : (q n : ZMod 2011) = 1283 :=
  (power_dimension_2011 n).trans B_cast_2011
theorem q_cast_auxiliary (n : ℕ) : (q n : ZMod auxiliary) = 37435 :=
  (power_dimension_auxiliary n).trans B_cast_auxiliary

private theorem mod_of_cast {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (a b : ℕ)
    (h : (a : ZMod m) = (b : ZMod m)) (hb : b < m) : a % m = b := by
  have hv := congrArg ZMod.val h
  simpa only [ZMod.val_natCast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hb] using hv

theorem quadratic_mod_47 (n : ℕ) : (q n^2-1) % 47 = 5 := by
  apply mod_of_cast _ 5 _ (by decide)
  rw [Nat.cast_sub (quadratic_ge_one n), Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_one, q_cast_47]
  reduce_mod_char

theorem quadratic_mod_2011 (n : ℕ) : (q n^2-1) % 2011 = 1090 := by
  apply mod_of_cast _ 1090 _ (by decide)
  rw [Nat.cast_sub (quadratic_ge_one n), Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_one, q_cast_2011]
  reduce_mod_char

theorem quadratic_mod_auxiliary (n : ℕ) : (q n^2-1) % auxiliary = 99282 := by
  apply mod_of_cast _ 99282 _ (by decide)
  rw [Nat.cast_sub (quadratic_ge_one n), Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_one, q_cast_auxiliary]
  unfold auxiliary
  reduce_mod_char

/-- The natural coupling factor reduces to the actual checked H expression. -/
theorem coupling_cast {p : ℕ} (rw n : ℕ)
    (hn : (q n : ZMod p) = (B : ZMod p))
    (hw : ((B^(dimension rw) : ℕ) : ZMod p) = (B : ZMod p)) :
    ((1+q n*A rw : ℕ) : ZMod p) =
      ((1+B*CurrentKernel2011.K+B^2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) := by
  simp only [A, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow] at *
  rw [hn, hw]
  ring

theorem coupling_mod_47 (rw n : ℕ) : (1+q n*A rw) % 47 = 29 := by
  have h := coupling_cast rw n (power_dimension_47 n) (power_dimension_47 rw)
  exact ((ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff' _ _ _).mp h).trans
    CurrentKernelResidues2011.Hs_mod_47

theorem coupling_mod_2011 (rw n : ℕ) : (1+q n*A rw) % 2011 = 674 := by
  have h := coupling_cast rw n (power_dimension_2011 n) (power_dimension_2011 rw)
  exact ((ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff' _ _ _).mp h).trans
    CurrentKernelResidues2011.Hs_mod_2011

private theorem transport_modulus (a m n r : ℕ) (hm : m = n)
    (h : a % m = r) : a % n = r := hm ▸ h

theorem coupling_mod_auxiliary (rw n : ℕ) :
    (1+q n*A rw) % auxiliary = 36379 := by
  have h := coupling_cast rw n (power_dimension_auxiliary n) (power_dimension_auxiliary rw)
  exact ((ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff' _ _ _).mp h).trans
    (transport_modulus _ 120199 auxiliary 36379 rfl
      CurrentKernelResidues2011.Hs_mod_auxiliary)

private theorem coprime_of_mod_ne_zero {x p : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p)
    (h : x % p ≠ 0) : Nat.Coprime x p := by
  apply (hp.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mpr ?_).symm
  intro hd
  exact h (Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd hd)

theorem radix_coprime {p : ℕ} (ho : Odd p) :
    Nat.Coprime CurrentMasks2011.radix p :=
  (Nat.coprime_two_left.mpr ho).pow_left 47

private theorem gamma_coprime_of_factors (rw n p : ℕ) (ho : Odd p)
    (hs : Nat.Coprime (q n^2-1) p)
    (hh : Nat.Coprime (1+q n*A rw) p) : Nat.Coprime (Gamma rw n) p := by
  have hr : Nat.Coprime (CurrentMasks2011.radix^977) p :=
    (radix_coprime ho).pow_left 977
  exact (hr.mul_left hs).mul_left hh

theorem coprime_Gamma_47 (rw n : ℕ) : Nat.Coprime (Gamma rw n) 47 := by
  apply gamma_coprime_of_factors rw n 47 (by decide)
  · apply coprime_of_mod_ne_zero prime_47
    rw [quadratic_mod_47]
    decide
  · apply coprime_of_mod_ne_zero prime_47
    rw [coupling_mod_47]
    decide

theorem coprime_Gamma_2011 (rw n : ℕ) : Nat.Coprime (Gamma rw n) 2011 := by
  apply gamma_coprime_of_factors rw n 2011 (by decide)
  · apply coprime_of_mod_ne_zero prime_2011
    rw [quadratic_mod_2011]
    decide
  · apply coprime_of_mod_ne_zero prime_2011
    rw [coupling_mod_2011]
    decide

theorem coprime_Gamma_auxiliary (rw n : ℕ) :
    Nat.Coprime (Gamma rw n) auxiliary := by
  apply gamma_coprime_of_factors rw n auxiliary auxiliary_odd
  · apply coprime_of_mod_ne_zero prime_auxiliary
    rw [quadratic_mod_auxiliary]
    decide
  · apply coprime_of_mod_ne_zero prime_auxiliary
    rw [coupling_mod_auxiliary]
    decide

/-- Unit at the complete actual modulus d*N, with independent width exponent. -/
theorem coprime_Gamma_width_cells (rw n : ℕ) :
    Nat.Coprime (Gamma rw n) (d*dimension n) := by
  rw [d_factors]
  exact ((coprime_Gamma_47 rw n).mul_right (coprime_Gamma_2011 rw n)).mul_right
    ((coprime_Gamma_auxiliary rw n).pow_right n)

theorem isUnit_Gamma_width_cells (rw n : ℕ) :
    IsUnit (Gamma rw n : ZMod (d*dimension n)) :=
  (ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime _ _).mpr (coprime_Gamma_width_cells rw n)

/-- The natural subtraction in Gamma agrees with the actual signed rank step. -/
theorem Gamma_cast_rankGamma (rw n : ℕ) :
    (Gamma rw n : ℤ) = NativeRankVariation.rankGamma (q n : ℤ) (A rw : ℤ)
      ((CurrentMasks2011.radix : ℤ)^977) := by
  simp only [Gamma, NativeRankVariation.rankGamma, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow,
    Nat.cast_sub (quadratic_ge_one n), Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_add]

theorem Gamma_pos (rw n : ℕ) : 0 < Gamma rw n := by
  have hq := q_gt_one n
  have hs : 0 < q n^2-1 := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt (by nlinarith)
  have hr : 0 < CurrentMasks2011.radix^977 := pow_pos (by decide) _
  exact mul_pos (mul_pos hr hs) (by omega)

/-- The tested bit is determined by the low residue even when the
unreduced digit contains a large multiple of2048. -/
theorem bit3_clear_of_residue {x : ℕ} (hx : x%2048 ≤ 5) : x &&& 8 = 0 := by
  apply (PaddingStaircase.bit3_mask_iff x).mpr
  have hb : (x%2048).testBit 3 = false := Nat.testBit_lt_two_pow (by omega)
  have he := Nat.testBit_mod_two_pow x 11 3
  change (x%2048).testBit 3 = _ at he
  simp only [show (3 < 11) = True from propext (by decide),decide_true,Bool.true_and] at he
  rwa [he] at hb

/-!
# Positive scalar witnesses from the actual constructed words

The normalization is first constructed without a high mask or controller.
Its proved size bounds supply alpha and strong slack; its exact modular
transport supplies z. The printed transport factor is one, not zero.
This is a partial scalar construction, not a full source-system solution.
-/

theorem scalar_witness (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) (dummy marker : ZMod N → ℕ)
    (hd : ∀ j, dummy j ≤ 1) (hm : ∀ j, marker j ≤ 1) (ha : a 0=0) (s : ℕ)
    (k digits : ZMod (N*2011) → ℕ)
    (hf : CurrentCarryConstruction2011.Facts
      (CurrentWordConstruction2011.word a dummy marker) (displacement s) k digits) :
    ScalarFacts (q N) (source a dummy marker) (normalized digits) (multiplier s)
      (alpha (q N) (source a dummy marker) (normalized digits))
      (quotientWitness (q N) ((CurrentKernel2011.K+multiplier s)*source a dummy marker)) ∧
    (source a dummy marker-1) &&&
      (lowPort*NativeMaskPopulation.repunit width N+1)=0 := by
  have hC := (assembled_source_bounds a dummy marker hd hm ha).1
  obtain ⟨hF,hFlt⟩ := normalized_word_strict a dummy marker hd hm s k digits hf
  have hs := strong_slack a dummy marker hd hm s k digits hf
  have hab : source a dummy marker+normalized digits < q N := by omega
  have hapos : 0<alpha (q N) (source a dummy marker) (normalized digits) := by
    unfold alpha
    omega
  have hbalance : source a dummy marker+normalized digits+
      alpha (q N) (source a dummy marker) (normalized digits)=q N := by
    unfold alpha
    omega
  have ht := quotient_transport hFlt hf.transport
  have hz := quotientWitness_pos (q N)
    ((CurrentKernel2011.K+multiplier s)*source a dummy marker)
  have hu := transport_factor_eq_one (q_pos (N := N)) hz ht
  refine ⟨⟨q_pos,hC,hF,pow_pos (by decide : 0<2) _,hapos,hz,
    hbalance,hs,?_,?_,ht,?_⟩,assembled_low_mask a dummy marker hd hm ha⟩
  · omega
  · omega
  · simpa only [source,normalized,multiplier,CurrentKernel2011.radix,
      CurrentMasks2011.radix,Nat.cast_mul,Nat.cast_add] using hu

/-- No normalization or desired quotient/slack conclusion is assumed here. -/
theorem exists_scalar_witness (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) (dummy marker : ZMod N → ℕ)
    (hd : ∀ j, dummy j ≤ 1) (hm : ∀ j, marker j ≤ 1) (ha : a 0=0) (s : ℕ) :
    ∃ k digits : ZMod (N*2011) → ℕ,
      CurrentCarryConstruction2011.Facts
        (CurrentWordConstruction2011.word a dummy marker) (displacement s) k digits ∧
      ScalarFacts (q N) (source a dummy marker) (normalized digits) (multiplier s)
        (alpha (q N) (source a dummy marker) (normalized digits))
        (quotientWitness (q N) ((CurrentKernel2011.K+multiplier s)*source a dummy marker)) ∧
      (source a dummy marker-1) &&&
        (lowPort*NativeMaskPopulation.repunit width N+1)=0 := by
  obtain ⟨k,digits,hf⟩ := CurrentCarryConstruction2011.exists_assembled_normalization
    a dummy marker hd hm (displacement s)
  exact ⟨k,digits,hf,scalar_witness a dummy marker hd hm ha s k digits hf⟩
